snippet.title: 1 Person Company with 7 AI Tools | Make Money with Claude & ChatGPT
snippet.description:
✅ Join No Code App Building Bootcamp 👉 https://roydigital.in/nocode-bootcamp

Aaj ki date mein maximum log har kaam ke liye sirf ek hi AI app use karte hain, aur wo hai ChatGPT. Ye bilkul waisa hai jaise dukaan mein ek hi ladka rakha ho jo subah dukaan kholne se le kar safai, purchase, customer aur shaam ka hisaab tak sab kuch akela kare. Kaam ho jaata hai, par har kaam mein best nahi hota.

Is video mein main aapko apne 7 AI employees se milwata hoon, yaani wo 7 AI tools jo main khud apni one person company mein use karta hoon. Har tool kis kaam ke liye best hai, kaise shuru karein, uska chhota sa catch kya hai, aur end mein wo ek galti jo zyada tar log karte hain.

Video ke 7 AI employees:

1. ChatGPT: roz ke kaam, post ideas, WhatsApp reply, offer banner image, voice mode, memory
2. Claude: Projects mein apne business ka brief de kar proper proposal aur lamba kaam
3. Gemini: Google ka apna AI, Gmail, Drive aur YouTube ke saath
4. Perplexity: research jo sources ke saath aati hai
5. Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM): apne documents aur PDFs se summary aur audio overview
6. Canva: ready templates aur type karke design
7. Make.com: bina coding automation, jaise Gmail aur ChatGPT ko jod kar reply

Sabse badi galti: AI kholo, ek sawaal pucho aur jo generic reply aaye use hi answer maan lo. Iska fix hai brain of your business, yaani ek document jisme aapke business aur aapke baare mein utni info ho jitni aap share karne mein comfortable ho. Har AI tool ko isse ek baar train karo, phir answer generic nahi, aapke business ke hisaab se aata hai.

How to make a Roblox game with AI: my full Claude Code workflow, every tool, model and API, and how to set it up yourself.

MY AI ROBLOX DEV COURSE: everything I've personally learned about using AI for Roblox development, out now: https://payhip.com/b/S9gWL

After my AI-made Roblox game videos, the most common comment was asking for a tutorial. So this is the whole system behind them: how I use Claude Code (running Claude Opus 5.5) to build entire Roblox games, from the code and the UI to maps, VFX, sound, animation and 3D models, and why I picked every tool along the way.

You'll learn what Claude Code skills are and how a SKILL.md file works (name, description, scripts and references), how to make your own skill or let the skill creator build one for you, and how MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects Claude to Roblox Studio. I show the step-by-step setup for the built-in Roblox Studio MCP server, how Rojo keeps the Luau code in files, and how to set up a Roblox Open Cloud API key safely so Claude can upload models and images straight into your game without ever pasting the key into the chat.

For the parts Claude can't do on its own, I break down the AI models and APIs I use and what they cost: Flux on Cloudflare Workers AI for images and icons, Hi3DGen on a free Kaggle GPU for 3D models, Blender to get them under Roblox's triangle limit, and the Roblox Open Cloud API for uploads. Then I go through every skill one by one and how my create-roblox-game skill manages the research, design and build of a whole game.
